Corollary
[Universal scaled derivative bounds in dimension three] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0171, page-0172 ↗ cor:chow-iii-3d-kappa-improved-compactness ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-scaled-derivative-estimates 1. ch20:20.19\group Derivative Estimates

There is a universal $\eta _0<\infty $, independent of $\kappa $, such that every three-dimensional $\kappa $-solution satisfies \[ | abla R|\le \eta _0R^{3/2}, \qquad |\partial _tR|\le \eta _0R^2. \] More generally, constants $\eta (\ell ,m)$ independent of $\kappa $ bound $|\partial _t^\ell abla ^m\Rm |$ by $\eta (\ell ,m)R^{1+\ell +m/2}$.
